seasonIndex.plot: A valiant girl liberates the Monkey King -- a god long trapped in stone -- in a quest to find seven sacred scrolls and save the world from evil.
The quest for sacred scrolls continues for the Monkey King and friends. But in a world of demons, gods and magic, everything comes at a cost.

seasons.plot: A valiant girl liberates the Monkey King -- a god long trapped in stone -- in a quest to find seven sacred scrolls and save the world from evil.

episodes.name: Hope Must Never Die
episodes.plot: A girl uncovers a statue of the legendary Monkey King, but in order to release this ancient God from his stone prison she must first find his golden crown, a crown that has fallen into the hands of Demons.

translations.value: Hope Must Never Die

A girl uncovers a statue of the legendary Monkey King, but in order to release this ancient God from his stone prison she must first find his golden crown, a crown that has fallen into the hands of Demons.

episodes.name: Ai confini del nulla
episodes.plot: Having released the Monkey King, Tripitaka is shocked to find him indifferent to the Scholar's mission. Struggling to keep him on side, and still being pursued by Demons, she finds help in the unlikeliest of places.

translations.value: Ai confini del nulla

Having released the Monkey King, Tripitaka is shocked to find him indifferent to the Scholar's mission. Struggling to keep him on side, and still being pursued by Demons, she finds help in the unlikeliest of places.

episodes.name: Il viaggio comincia
episodes.plot: When Monkey and Sandy find themselves prisoners to Princess Locke, an escaped Tripitaka must convince Pigsy to abandon his mistress and help her rescue the two Gods.

translations.value: Il viaggio comincia
When Monkey and Sandy find themselves prisoners to Princess Locke, an escaped Tripitaka must convince Pigsy to abandon his mistress and help her rescue the two Gods.

episodes.name: Il Re Monkey ritorna
episodes.plot: As the heroes set off to the Western Mountains they are intercepted by a gang of rebel bandits, who worship the legend of the Monkey King. When the leader discovers Tripitaka can control the crown he plans to capture Monkey.

translations.value: Il Re Monkey ritorna

As the heroes set off to the Western Mountains they are intercepted by a gang of rebel bandits, who worship the legend of the Monkey King. When the leader discovers Tripitaka can control the crown he plans to capture Monkey.

episodes.name: Nella Terra di rottura
episodes.plot: Monkey, Pigsy and Sandy are glamoured by a mystical shamanic Demon and taken to a strange prison called the Breaking Ground.

translations.value: Nella Terra di rottura
Monkey, Pigsy and Sandy are glamoured by a mystical shamanic Demon and taken to a strange prison called the Breaking Ground.

episodes.name: Un diadema non fa di te un Re
episodes.plot: As Monkey travels further into his past Tripitaka must act quickly before he is lost forever. Using the sutra, she is able to find a way to go after Monkey, and in doing so unravels the mystery of his imprisonment.

translations.value: Un diadema non fa di te un Re

As Monkey travels further into his past Tripitaka must act quickly before he is lost forever. Using the sutra, she is able to find a way to go after Monkey, and in doing so unravels the mystery of his imprisonment.

episodes.name: Finchè non ti ho incontrato
episodes.plot: As Tripitaka, Monkey, Pigsy and Sandy flee from the Shaman and his Demonic henchman, they seek shelter in a sprawling forest.

translations.value: Finchè non ti ho incontrato
As Tripitaka, Monkey, Pigsy and Sandy flee from the Shaman and his Demonic henchman, they seek shelter in a sprawling forest.

episodes.name: Una parte di te che manca
episodes.plot: Tripitaka leaves the quest to go in search of her mother, but Sandy won't let her travel alone, and the two journey to the North Water.

translations.value: Una parte di te che manca
Tripitaka leaves the quest to go in search of her mother, but Sandy won't let her travel alone, and the two journey to the North Water.

episodes.name: In cerca di Tripitaka
episodes.plot: As Monkey and Pigsy hide in plain sight within the walls of Davari's palace, Tripitaka realises why Davari is so determined to translate the Sacred Scrolls. Can she stop him completing the translation before it's too late?

translations.value: In cerca di Tripitaka

episodes.name: Un eroe per salvarci tutti
episodes.plot: While Monkey and Pigsy smuggle themselves into Davari's banquet, Tripitaka must work out the means of controlling the secret army of the Font Demons before Davari can reveal the extent of his new powers.

translations.value: Un eroe per salvarci tutti

seasons.plot: The quest for sacred scrolls continues for the Monkey King and friends. But in a world of demons, gods and magic, everything comes at a cost.

episodes.name: Il cimitero degli dei
episodes.plot: Re Monkey, Tripitaka, Pigsy e Sandy partono alla ricerca delle scritture sacre. I demoni vengono a sapere del ritorno di Monkey e giurano di distruggerlo.

translations.value: Il cimitero degli dei

episodes.name: La ricerca del sapere
episodes.plot: All'Archivio delle Eterne Scritture, Monkey e i suoi amici devono risolvere diversi indovinelli (e sopravvivere) per poter accedere alla Scrittura del Sapere.

translations.value: La ricerca del sapere
All'Archivio delle Eterne Scritture, Monkey e i suoi amici devono risolvere diversi indovinelli (e sopravvivere) per poter accedere alla Scrittura del Sapere.

episodes.name: Villaggio dei bambini perduti
episodes.plot: Una demone mutaforma usa i suoi poteri per assumere l'aspetto di Sandy, quindi rapisce i bambini del villaggio per fare apparire malvagi Monkey e i suoi compagni.

translations.value: Villaggio dei bambini perduti

episodes.name: Il burattinaio
episodes.plot: Sul sentiero della Scrittura della Creazione, il demone Hagfish rivela chi muove i fili quando intrappola Tripitaka nella sua collezione di bambole.

translations.value: Il burattinaio
Sul sentiero della Scrittura della Creazione, il demone Hagfish rivela chi muove i fili quando intrappola Tripitaka nella sua collezione di bambole.

episodes.name: Il paradiso ritrovato
episodes.plot: Re Monkey e i suoi compagni incontrano la misteriosa Mycelia in un giardino troppo bello per essere vero, poi aiutano Pigsy a sfuggire a un destino saporito ma mortale.

translations.value: Il paradiso ritrovato

episodes.name: I gladiatori
episodes.plot: Monkey escogita un piano per recuperare le scritture dal demone Gorm fingendosi umano, mentre una disputa tra i generali dei demoni sfocia in una battaglia epica.

translations.value: I gladiatori

episodes.name: Il capo cuoco
episodes.plot: I demoni si dirigono verso Rocca Cuor di Leone per combattere Monkey e Pigsy deve affinare le abilità culinarie per far colpo sul Generale Khan come suo chef personale.

translations.value: Il capo cuoco

episodes.name: Il vero Tripitaka
episodes.plot: Secondo le scritture dovrebbe esserci un solo Tripitaka... ma quando Monkey e i suoi amici arrivano a Rocca Cuor di Leone scoprono che potrebbe non essere proprio così.

episodes.name: La tela del ragno
episodes.plot: L'esercito ribelle ignora l'avvertimento di Tripitaka e poi se ne pente sul campo di battaglia. Hagfish crea un clone i cui poteri potrebbero eguagliare quelli di Monk

episodes.name: Ingabbiando l'oscurità
episodes.plot: Con i ribelli dispersi e il destino delle scritture sacre ancora a rischio, Monkey si rende conto di essere il peggior nemico di se stesso... su diversi fronti.
